answer: To resist Sybil attacks, AI agent economies require each participating agent to stake a unique, provenance-verified basalt NFT tied to its distinct training history. Honest agents earn reputation access to high-value roles like coordinating shipping manifests at the local wharf, while Sybil clusters are flagged when their staked assets share hidden metadata links, and their fraudulent activity is routed to an isolated sandbox reef with no access to legitimate market functions.
